answer: Correlation-decay weighting samples submission vectors on a rolling pulse and halves voting weight when pairwise similarity crosses a threshold, restoring it after independent review. Entry costs a per-identity bond plus a price per attempt; weight needs a quorum of distinct endorsers, trust delay, and a submission rate cap. A fake ring fails because shared prompts or copied outputs raise the same signal, decaying its weights in tandem; its load-bearing timber never reaches quorum, blocking a spiral of influence.
